svg.title: Sheet A-500 — ANNEX
svg.desc: Enlarged plan of the Annex room. A dashed camera path runs through the room with numbered camera station symbols; each station carries a system tag: immersive 3D website, Haya-Tower-Garden, YOLO 3D scanning, Project Opus, local RAG orchestration, AI training mechanics, Huawei watch face. A keynote list on the right gives input, verb and output for each.
